role: Exact prerequisite matrix for alternative complete first public records and all pre-existing same-flux private errors
question: Which of the three other base-positive complete first charge records retain positive support for each of the twelve same-flux alternative physical errors, so a later matched second-record discriminator is identifiable?

fork_classification.first_record: All three other outcomes on the two base-variable charge sites are independent reversible in-scope tests; run all, with no human ranking.
fork_classification.error_support: Cross every first outcome with all twelve already pinned shortest-trivial-loop alternatives; no preferred peer or post-result selection.
fork_classification.geometry: A different lattice/orbit is not needed to test first-record feasibility and would require a new physical-state pin and cost audit; hold the current L=2 geometry fixed here. A later geometry contract is contingent on whether this cheaper prerequisite yields usable positive pairs and a second-law witness.
fork_classification.dependency: Exact first-record positivity gates any conditional second-law comparison; this tick stops at the prerequisite and does not infer a second-law difference from positivity.

source_basis: J7M exact base first and second public record
J7T twelve same-flux alternative errors and all-plus first masses
J7Z complete-second-law null for the selected all-plus first record
frozen_model: Paper-normalized ideal periodic L=2 D4 projector orbit, 36 red edges and 24 public charge sites. The first binary public record is measured after private IID red-X error and before any public charge action. Error identity and orbit factors stay private. A later second public record must be action-conditioned on a relation-free public action, not on the private error. No new error support, geometry, rate, noisy channel, policy or logical score is introduced here.

matrix.full_binary_record: For every error and charge-site set, keep the same 24-bit first flux, set only the named charge bits to one, set vacuum=not(flux or charge) sitewise, and require all other eligible charge bits zero.
matrix.exact_mass: For candidate-specific variable first sites, use the ordered commuting star projector with eigenvalues -1 on the named charge sites and +1 elsewhere. A requested negative eigenvalue at a deterministic-plus site has exact mass zero. Never expose candidate-specific variable sites to a decoder or public-action rule.
matrix.independent_unit: One exact error-by-complete-first-record cell; no Monte Carlo sample or bootstrap unit.
matrix.uncertainty: Finite exact rational masses have no Monte Carlo interval; conditional positivity on this selected ideal orbit does not generalize to full IID-channel information.

acceptance: All thirteen pre-existing errors crossed with control plus all three alternate base-positive full-binary first records
Exact all-plus masses replay J7M/J7T and four base masses are 1/4 each and normalize
Input and runner SHA-256 pins pass before and after; same public flux and valid charge/vacuum arrays
Report positivity and mass only, with no second-law, information, logical-risk, noisy-JIT or threshold claim

outcomes.positive_pairs: Preserve all positive cells, then preregister a bounded exact second-law matrix across every usable alternative first record and both fixed actions before any information inference.
outcomes.no_positive_pairs: The three alternate base first records cannot compare this thirteen-support error set; next separately audit alternative error support or geometry within a new explicit budget.
outcomes.censored: Any pin, orbit, flux, exact replay, positivity, normalization, term-cap or CPU failure releases no feasibility conclusion.

stop_rule: Stop after exactly 52 error-by-first-record cells, or sooner on a gate failure; do not sample histories, compute second laws or arm/risk evaluations.
